apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Some features rely on external services that require a personal key. Keys are stored in the system keychain, never in a file.

acoustid.name: AcoustID
acoustid.why: Identifies a track by its acoustic fingerprint (the audio itself, not its name). This is what finds the right studio version of a song and automatically fills in album, year, track number and cover art. Free key at acoustid.org.

rateLimits.title: API rate limits
rateLimits.description: Controls how cautious the app is when calling external services during library-wide batch operations.

lastfmDelay.name: Delay between Last.fm requests
lastfmDelay.why: When a track has no MusicBrainz genre at all, the "Recompute genres" action queries Last.fm to find one. That API key is shared by every beets user in the world: a delay between requests keeps it from getting temporarily blocked for everyone.
lastfmDelay.estimate: For {{count}} genre-less tracks at this pace: about {{duration}}.
lastfmDelay.warning: Below one second isn't recommended: stay polite to Last.fm and avoid hitting it with too many requests too close together.
